remarks: Welcome to 12001 West Street, a charming 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom single story home ideally situated in the heart of Garden Grove. Offering approximately 1,232 square feet of living space on a spacious 6,360 square foot corner lot, this home features a comfortable and functional floor plan with plenty of opportunity to make it your own. The generous lot provides ample space for outdoor enjoyment, entertaining, or creating your own private retreat. Conveniently located near local schools, parks, shopping, dining, and everyday amenities, this home offers the convenience of eateries across the street and easy access to major freeways for commuting throughout Orange County.
